headline: Reddit's r/opensource subreddit bans AI-made projects and non-English speakers
summary: The r/opensource subreddit's moderators introduced new submission rules banning AI-built, AI-focused and AI-using projects, while also excluding non-English speakers, solo developers and fledgling projects. The rules impose requirements on project age and contributors and have sparked backlash, including over how the policy conflicts with Linux's acceptance of disclosed AI-assisted code.

claims.statement: r/opensource's moderators posted new rules banning projects that use AI.
The new rules also exclude non-English speakers.
The rules bar AI-built, AI-focused and AI-using projects, announced October 24.
